title: Course Module Spec
description: Input spec consumed by the /build-module command of the course-builder plugin. Describes one course module and drives the 9 subagents + 2 skills + 2 hooks that produce the artifact bundle.

curso.description: The course this module belongs to.

publico_alvo.description: Target audience profile. Free-text, but should be specific enough to drive tone/depth of generated artifacts.

aulas.description: Ordered list of lessons in this module. At least one is required.

topicos.description: Concrete topics the lesson covers. Drives lesson-plan, slides and script generation. Non-empty.

duracao_min.description: Optional lesson duration in minutes. Omit if the module default applies.

ferramenta_base.description: Base AI tool the module teaches. Pinned version is consumed by bug-smith/qa-reviewer to mitigate tool-rot.

versao.description: Concrete version floor (e.g. '2.1'). Used to scope generated examples and bug-smith behavior.

filosofia.description: Pedagogical contract for the module. Both flags default to true.

artifact_first.description: Every interaction ends in a versionable artifact, never chatbot Q&A.

hitl_so_grave.description: Human-in-the-loop only on grave/risky paths; automate the safe path.

branding.description: Visual/organizational identity for generated artifacts. Optional; when omitted, the orchestrator derives org from curso.nome and uses a default accent color.

cor_acento.description: Hex accent color used in HTML portal and slides.

pesquisar_tendencias.description: Whether the trend-researcher subagent runs. Defaults to true. Set false to skip web research (e.g. offline runs, rate-limited environment).
